props.heading: Media Literacy Lesson
props.description: Check the evidence before you share

props.text: "Miracle Fruit Cures Sleep Problems Overnight, Doctors Stunned"

props.title: Evidence Checklist
props.subtitle: Look for these signals before trusting the claim

props.title: Named source
props.description: Does the story cite a study, organization, or expert you can look up?

props.title: Original research
props.description: Is there a published paper with sample size, methods, and peer review?

props.title: Matching evidence
props.description: Does the evidence actually support the strength of the headline?

props.title: Independent confirmation
props.description: Have other credible outlets reported the same findings?

props.title: 1. Who benefits from this claim?
props.description: Consider whether a company, product, or advocate stands to gain from people believing it.

props.title: 2. What is missing from the story?
props.description: Look for absent context, sample sizes, side effects, or opposing expert views.

props.title: 3. Would I bet on this being true?
props.description: If the claim is wrong, what would it cost? Verify before posting if the stakes are high.
